bounds.note: per_output_union_k<k> applies to every uniform fan-in-k row-group support (<= n_rec k-input support records per output; 'per_output_union' = the K16 value, kept for continuity); it does not apply to multi-tile (U*) or mixed / anchored supports; the one-tile bound only to ONE common partition per set

support_stats.rng: torch.Generator('cpu') (mt19937) seeded per purpose / chunk with sha256-derived 63-bit seeds; permutation = stable argsort of int64 keys uniform in [0, 2^62); ties -> lower local position

quad_sample_rule: 10,000,000 (50M when the enabled density <= 0.10, else 10M; predeclared)

predictions.model: independent rounds: 1 - prod_r (1 - p_g(t) mean_{q in r} h_q); p_g = C(63, t-1) / C(1023, t-1)
predictions.note: fixed partition: (used tiles / nkt) a_t per set is an APPROXIMATION -- the tiles are ranges of the sorted set, so the same nearby-id tuples share a tile in every set (rank correlation)

sharing.identity: exact sorted global-input set (D-bit bitmap of feat[q][enabled local coordinates])

triple.sampling: simple random sample of distinct tuples without replacement; unit = query (all selected outputs of a query kept together); finite-population correction 1 - n / N
triple.conditional_on: the fixed selected outputs (not a random sample of all outputs)

bootstrap.method: query-cluster bootstrap = multinomial resampling of the c_i histogram, deviations scaled by sqrt(FPC)

quad.sampling: simple random sample of distinct tuples without replacement; unit = query (all selected outputs of a query kept together); finite-population correction 1 - n / N
quad.conditional_on: the fixed selected outputs (not a random sample of all outputs)

bootstrap.method: query-cluster bootstrap = multinomial resampling of the c_i histogram, deviations scaled by sqrt(FPC)
